# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen years old (by Volume 4)  <sub>[v4 c36 P4](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is a fair child with long, sleek hazel-eyed curls that never get out of order, hazel eyes that are gentle and mild, a straight nose, and a prim mouth. She always looks neat and well-kept, as if she has just been starched and ironed.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025)_

## Personality

Dora is extremely quiet, prim, meek, and well-behaved. She is a neat, faithful, and obedient child who rarely causes trouble and follows directions carefully. Though she is calm and seldom easily flustered, she can be timid and afraid of the dark or family ghost stories.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c10 P14](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0014), [v2 c10 P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)_

- Careful, systematic gardening  <sub>[v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010)</sub>

## History

Dora and her twin brother Davy are orphaned children brought to Green Gables by Marilla Cuthbert after their mother's death. Unlike her twin Davy, Dora is well-behaved, obedient, and causes very little trouble, though Davy frequently tricks her or drags her into mischief. She attends school in Avonlea, sits with various friends, and participates in Sunday School diligently. When Richard Keith leaves a trust fund for the twins, Marilla and Anne are able to keep them permanently at Green Gables. As she grows up, Dora proves to be very sensible, womanly, and helpful, eventually taking over Anne's old porch room when Anne gets married. By the age of seventeen, she has a suitor named Ralph Andrews.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 c8 P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 c10 P36](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0036), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P23](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0023), [v3 c13 P0](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0000), [v3 c13 P37](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0037), [v4 c4 P2](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0002), [v4 c4 P5](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0005), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007), [v4 c36 P3](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0003), [v4 c36 P5](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0005)_

## Background by volume

- Her father died when she was a baby, and her mother was sick for a long time before dying  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008), [v2 c8 P13](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0013)</sub>
- Has a twin brother named Davy  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Left $2,000 in trust by her late uncle, Richard Keith  <sub>[v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)</sub>
